ValidationRule.description: Requires a W&L EAA greater than 0 whenever W_L_BU__c is checked. Applies to every save except insert, so Lead conversion still succeeds. Skipped for users with the Bypass_Opportunity_Validation permission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Validation), NOT(ISNEW()), W_L_BU__c = TRUE, OR(ISBLANK(W_L_EAA__c), W_L_EAA__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter a W&L EAA greater than 0 when W&L BU is checked.
